_comment: Schema (with worked example values shown as placeholders, NOT real measurements) for the completed iOS on-device benchmark result. This is a NEW file distinct from the pre-existing ios_benchmark/benchmark_manifest.json, which is the pre-run handoff manifest (checkpoint refs, test config, placeholder schema). Save a real completed run using this shape as a new dated file per DEVICE_BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md step 8 -- do not overwrite benchmark_manifest.json.

release_under_test.release_status_at_time_of_benchmark: FROZEN_DESKTOP_VALIDATED (per docs/releases/v8.11_production/RELEASE_MANIFEST.json -- ios_on_device_status was PENDING before this benchmark)

layer1.tflite_sha256_recomputed_on_device: <TODO: shasum -a 256 on the Mac/device-side copy, must equal tflite_sha256_expected -- if it does not, STOP and re-copy, do not proceed>

layer2.tflite_sha256_recomputed_on_device: <TODO: shasum -a 256 on the Mac/device-side copy, must equal tflite_sha256_expected>

checkpoint_provenance.combined_size_bytes_on_device: <TODO: actual on-disk size once bundled into the app, may differ slightly due to app-bundle packaging/compression>

routing_rule_implemented: <TODO: 'production_composite' (Layer2 always runs, matches pipeline.py exactly) OR 'strict_gate' (Layer2 skipped when Layer1 predicts real, matches only benchmark_mobile_artifacts.py's desktop approximation) -- MUST be recorded, see DEVICE_BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md step 1. Do not leave this field blank.

device_metadata.device_model: <TODO: e.g. iPhone15,3, from sysctlbyname("hw.machine") not the marketing name>
device_metadata.runtime: <TODO: e.g. TensorFlowLiteSwift 2.x.y -- record the exact linked runtime/version. CoreML was never verified in this project; if used instead of LiteRT, this must be flagged, not silently substituted>
device_metadata.threads: <TODO: int, LiteRT interpreter thread count actually configured>
device_metadata.benchmark_date_utc: <TODO: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the benchmark was run>
device_metadata.app_build_identifier: <TODO: e.g. git commit hash of the Swift project state, or Xcode build number, for reproducibility>

real_path.test_images_used: <TODO: list of the 20 real image filenames actually cycled through, should match TEST_ASSET_MANIFEST.csv's real rows>

per_run_raw_data.layer2_ms: <TODO: float or null -- null only valid if routing_rule_implemented=='strict_gate' and Layer1 predicted real>
per_run_raw_data.end_to_end_ms: <TODO: float, includes preprocessing + layer1 + [layer2] + routing decision>

manipulated_path.test_images_used: <TODO: list of the 20 manipulated (10 fake + 10 filter) image filenames actually cycled through, should match TEST_ASSET_MANIFEST.csv's fake+filter rows>

per_run_raw_data.layer2_ms: <TODO: float, always present for manipulated path>

initialization.init_ms: <TODO: float, one-time cost to load both .tflite models and allocate interpreter tensors, measured once, separate from per-image timed runs>

memory.peak_memory_mb: <TODO: float, peak resident memory during the timed-run phase, from a real on-device measurement API (os_proc_available_memory / Instruments Allocations), not an estimate>

prediction_consistency.n_images_compared: <TODO: int, should be up to 40 (all test images), or fewer if some were skipped -- record which and why>
prediction_consistency.desktop_reference_source: results/mobile_deployment_benchmark.json (tflite_float32 block, this project's own desktop CPU TFLite run)

stability_run.path_used: manipulated (per DEVICE_BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md step 5 -- exercises both models, the stricter test)
stability_run.crash_count: <TODO: int, must be 0 to pass gate 5>
stability_run.degradation_percent: <TODO: float, (last_100_mean_ms - first_100_mean_ms) / first_100_mean_ms * 100, must be <= 30 to pass gate 6>
stability_run.thermal_notes: <TODO: free text -- throttling observed, device warm/hot state, any anomalies>

acceptance_gate_evaluation.gate_2_real_path_p50_le_80ms: <TODO: PASS|FAIL|NOT_APPLICABLE (if routing_rule_implemented=='production_composite', this gate needs re-derivation per DEVICE_BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md step 1 -- do not force a PASS/FAIL against a threshold that assumed the other routing rule)>
acceptance_gate_evaluation.gate_7_prediction_consistency_matches_de: <TODO: PASS|FAIL, define your own threshold for 'matches' e.g. 100% or some tolerance -- BENCHMARK_ACCEPTANCE_GATE.md does not specify a numeric tolerance below 100%, treat any mismatch as worth investigating rather than averaging away>

overall_result: <TODO: 'ALL_GATES_PASSED' | 'PARTIAL_PASS' | 'FAILED' -- do not fill in until all 7 gates above have real evaluated values, not TODOs>
